name: Tochi Academy
description: Tochi Academy is an editorial WordPress theme designed for evening adult colleges and professional licensing academies. Styled with classical serif typography, delicate hairline circle motifs, and documentary photography, it provides comprehensive cohort schedules, week-by-week syllabus timelines, and transparent fee tables. Built for quiet legibility and disciplined academic presentation, it supports small-cohort vocational institutions balancing classroom learning with working life.
